name: SPAN · Nomos8k
author: Helaman (Philip Hofmann)
note: Best overall on LEGO instruction samples: keeps dense stud patterns, clean edges, very fast. Trained for photos with on-the-fly degradations. Full fp16 conversion verified on real images (fp32 vs fp16 max diff ~0.003); extreme noise input can push outputs out of range, so clamp to [0,1].
description: Best for instructions and diagrams — keeps fine repeated detail, very fast.

name: Real-ESRGAN AnimeVideo v3
author: Xintao Wang (xinntao)
note: Smallest/fastest. Clean lines, keeps studs, slightly softer than SPAN. Good fast default for diagrams.
description: Smallest and fastest; clean lines, a little softer.

name: Real-ESRGAN General v3
author: Xintao Wang (xinntao)
note: Keeps studs, bold clean lines with slight halos; good fast general/photo model.
description: General purpose; bold lines and JPEG cleanup.

name: MoSR · Nomos2 HQ
author: Helaman (Philip Hofmann)
note: Most faithful on the red/brick sample, keeps studs; slight texture noise on flat red faces. Good quality option at mid size.
description: Larger model for photos; the most faithful colors, slower.
